items.title: Atlantis Underground Base
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
You find yourself in the middle of the ocean, stranded on an abandoned island!
Make your way into the lost atlantis underground base and discover all its secrets!

+ Explore the lost underwater nation and start a great adventure!
+ 4 skins included!

items.title: Galaxy Pros
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: Orbit around space with the Galaxy Pros!

items.title: One Block: Lucky Skyblock
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Test how lucky you are with over 200 lucky block drops. You have an empty world to build in, but only a single block to gather resources from. Face epic or explosive results, and shape your world around them. 

+ 200+ different drops 
+ Guide books to complete 
+ 5 Custom lucky blocks
+ Skyblock style gameplay

items.title: Castle of Dranuvia
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
An Epic kingdom full of marvels and mysteries. Immerse yourself in the great halls of a titanic castle, walk through a medieval market and a harbor full of ships.
Adventure into the town where you can lose yourself in the beauty of an idyllic medieval kingdom.

- Expansive Castle
- Secret rooms & passages
- Flower fields, gardens, 3 guarded entrances

items.title: Cute Armor
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Look tough and adorable in colorful Cute Armor skins. Bright and pretty protective coverings will keep you safe as you role-play with friends fighting rough battles. In your shining shield and suit of armor, create an order of warriors with attractively brilliant gear. Defend your city while looking delightful.

+ 8 darling, durable HD skins

items.title: Hip Hop Demons
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
With plenty of attitude and cool fashion, get ready to rhyme in Hip Hop Demons skins. Gear up in colorful clothes and happening horns and role-play with friends as the coolest little devils around. Swing your gold chains while you bust some moves. Get ready to rap and show off your talents for all of Minecraft to see and enjoy.

+ 8 styling and spirited HD skins

items.title: Soul Guardians
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Protect nature and keep watch over all living creatures. Take care of life as you role-play with friends in powerful Soul Guardians skins. Choose the best skin to protect the earth and everything in it. Armed with a staff and filled with wisdom, preserve and defend the most magnificent creatures of the world.

+ 8 global defender HD skins

items.title: Anime Demons
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Get up to some mischief with big round eyes, wildly brilliant hair, and cute horns! Role-play as an adorable devilish creature in Anime Demons skins. In truly fabulous fashions, look like a real Japanese animation character and see what pranks you can pull. Laugh, cry, get mad, and maybe get into some trouble, manga style!

+ 8 colorful comic spirit HD skins

items.title: Manga Police
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Serve and protect all Minecraft residents in animated Manga Police skins. Wear your badge with pride when you role-play with friends and patrol the city streets. Walk your beat and keep your big, alert eyes wide open for any criminals. If your long, colorful hair gets in the way, put it up under your police cap and get back to business.

+ 8 marvelous magna-fied HD skins

items.title: Fashion Demons
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
The modern and stylish fashion demons are here! There are 8 fashionable demon skins to choose from, pick the style you like and roleplay with your friends. Be a trendy yet sneaky demon!

- 8 skins
- 100% stylish!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns.

items.title: Kigurumi Party
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Identify with your favorite animal with this cute skin pack. Enjoy and live unique moments.

- Twelve skins.
- One skin totally free.
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Farm Life Run
items.creator: Sandbox Network
items.description:
Peaceful afternoon, the animals in the barn have disappeared! Run and earn money through 15 stages to buy animals to fill with animals your barn!
- 15 stages
- 4 skins
- 3 animals can to buy

items.title: Neon Drip
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Transform into a neon drip skin with vivid and vibrant shades. From the infinite world, all the way to the end. Protect and defend your realm to become the most glowing warrior Minecraft has ever seen!

items.title: Ancient Lucky Blocks
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
Find and uncover the mysterious Ancient Lucky Blocks scattered around a ruined village from the deep past. Someone has tried very hard to keep these mysterious blocks away from prying eyes. Can you uncover all 64 Ancient Lucky Blocks?

- 4 awesome ancient style skins
- Lucky Block Trader to keep those lucky blocks coming 
- 64 Ancient Lucky Blocks hidden around the ruins

items.title: Star Space
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These skins are out of this world and space themed! You'll find a black hole, a solar system and so many other cool starry skins in this pack!

- 13 galactic skins

items.title: Horrors in Suits
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Some people were just born to devour the boardroom literally. These horrors don't hide their disappointment behind their scary smiles. If you're lucky they might have brought lunch from home.

- Includes 10 terrifying hungry horror skins in suits!
- Includes an "unleashed" horror skin!

items.title: Faceless Suits
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description: These faceless corporate monsters are here to ruin your day and block your proposal! They are armed with synergistic management solutions that'll leave you reconsidering your career trajectory! Count your lucky stars and maybe you'll survive their proposals.

items.title: Neon Suits
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Have the flashiest skin in the Minecraft server with the 'Neon Suits' skin set!

- 8 unique skins!
- Colorful, geometric designs!
- Perfect for cyberpunk fans!

items.title: Trendy Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These mobs are looking good and they know it! Wearing the latest trends in fashion, they're ready to shine!

- 8 mob skins!
- Wide variety of trendy outfits!

items.title: Impostor Lucky Blocks
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Welcome to a space station full of lucky blocks! Inside each block you will find tons of great resources, or be led into terrifying traps! Can you figure out which lucky blocks are the impostors, or will you be caught by their dangerous techniques?

- Over 100 lucky block events!
- Perfect for single or multiplayer!

items.title: Lucky Block Arena
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Team Workbench presents: Lucky Block Arena! Choose your team and open 64 Lucky Blocks in the preparing phase, then fight an epic PVP battle in the arena and claim victory!

Multiplayer recommended.

+ 1 Lucky Block & Arena
+ 160+ outcomes
+ Licensed by Team Workbench and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Fun Planes
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Fly 40+ Fun Planes and explore the airport with modern city. Fly a private jet, airliner or biplane! Become a flying pro and explore the world from the skies! 

+ Airport including control tower, runway, gateways & hangars
+ City with modern houses and skyscrapers
+ Advanced plane flying controls
+ 75 customizable colors for planes and cars
+ Free skin

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Life In Italy
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
There is so much to discover in Italy! Explore an epic immersive modern city of love, pizza, cars, art. Roleplay as a car driver, fisherman, office worker, captain. 

+Experience summer life in Italy now you are stuck at home
+ Modern custom city
+ Many cars & more
+ Roleplay in the city 
+ Survival & multiplayer friendly
+ Free skins

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Mobuto
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Mobuto! Mobsuke! You know what time it is. Roleplay as popular themed characters as one of your favorite mobs. Perfect to build your own hidden village! Or maybe even to have epic battles. Even attend a in game cosplay party. Really, the imagination is up to you. Enjoy these awesome ninja skins!

- 36 ninja skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug
